inputs.text: ABU DHABI, 22nd August, 2026 (WAM) -- The National Centre of Meteorology (NCM) issued an alert over the possibility of convective cloud formation accompanied by light to moderate rainfall, which may become heavy at times. The alert is in effect from 13:30 on Saturday until 21:00 the same day. The NCM said the weather conditions are expected to affect some eastern, southern and western areas, extending to parts of the country's interior.

requested_area.areaDesc: Eastern, southern and western areas (demo zone)

fields.description: NCM alert: convective clouds with light to moderate rain, possibly heavy at times, in some eastern, southern and western areas and parts of the interior. In effect Saturday 22 Aug 2026, 13:30 to 21:00.
fields.headline: NCM alert: rain, heavy at times, possible in eastern, southern and western areas
fields.instruction: Take extra care when driving in rain and avoid standing water. Follow updates at https://alerts.example.ae.
fields.note_for_reviewer: I set severity to Moderate and certainty to Possible because NCM describes light to moderate rain that may become heavy at times, and the source gives no time zone for 13:30–21:00. Please also check that the instruction, which is generic rain-safety advice not taken from the NCM text, fits your standard wording.

payload.summary: The alert matches the verified NCM bulletin. The hazard is the same: convective clouds with light to moderate rain that may be heavy at times. The times match (Saturday 22 Aug 2026, 13:30 to 21:00), and 22 Aug 2026 is a Saturday. The areas match: eastern, southern and western areas plus parts of the interior. Certainty 'Possible' fits the bulletin's 'possibility' wording. No unverified report is used.

no_basis.concern: The headline attributes the alert to 'NCM' (the National Center of Meteorology), but the sender is the demo national authority. This is a possible mismatch in who the public is told issued the alert. No clause shown covers attribution in headline text, and headline wording is largely outside this mandate.

The msgType is Alert, so no references are needed. No active alerts from other authorities could be overreached.

payload.summary: I compared the Arabic headline, description and instruction with the English and found no difference in meaning. The hazard (convective clouds; light to moderate rain, possibly heavy at times), the areas (some eastern, southern and western areas and parts of the interior), the date (Saturday 22 Aug 2026), the times (13:30 to 21:00), the protective action (take extra care when driving in rain, avoid standing water) and the URL all match. The Arabic was produced by machine translation, and this review does not approve it. A named person who reads Arabic must still review and approve the Arabic text before release.
